finance.subtitle: Billing, collection, receivables and spending — operational finance, not an accounting ledger.
finance.invoicesSubtitle: Invoices billed from contracts, milestones, projects and approved time.
finance.receivablesSubtitle: Open balances by days past due ({c}).
finance.paymentsSubtitle: Money received and how it was allocated to invoices.
finance.expensesSubtitle: All company spending with approval and payment status.
finance.myExpensesSubtitle: Your expense claims and their approval status.
finance.vendorsNote: Vendors are archived, never deleted — historical expenses keep their vendor. Purchase orders come with procurement later.
finance.reportsSubtitle: Operational reports: billed, collected, outstanding, spending and project profitability.
finance.setupSubtitle: Expense categories and internal hourly cost rates.
finance.newInvoiceSubtitle: Bill an eligible source, or create a manual invoice. Nothing is invoiced automatically.
finance.sourcesNote: Eligibility is deterministic: due or delivered contract milestones, contracts without milestones, accepted quotations without a contract, completed projects and approved billable time. A source can only be billed once.
finance.noInvoicesText: Create one from a billing source or as a manual invoice.
finance.noExpensesText: Create an expense, then submit it for approval.
finance.draftNote: Draft invoices have no number and are not sent to anyone. Issuing assigns the number and freezes the invoice.
finance.serverCalcNote: Totals are recalculated on the server when you save.
finance.issueText: Issue this invoice for {total}? It receives its number and can no longer be edited.
finance.issueNote: Seller and client details, payment instructions and VAT are frozen. Corrections later need a void and a replacement.
finance.sendNote: Record how the invoice reached the client. The system does not send email or WhatsApp.
finance.sendConfirm: I confirm the invoice was delivered to the client.
finance.cancelNote: The draft is cancelled. Linked time becomes billable again.
finance.voidNote: Voiding keeps the number and the issued PDF, but the invoice no longer counts. Only possible when nothing is paid (reverse payments first).
finance.voidReplace: Create a replacement draft with the same lines and source
finance.notePh: What happened? (call, promise to pay, reminder sent…)
finance.manualReminderNote: Reminders are recorded manually — the system does not contact the client.
finance.sourceNote: Finance only references the commercial source; it never changes the contract, quotation or project.
finance.vatSnapshotNote: The VAT rate is stored on each line when the invoice is saved; later changes to company VAT do not affect issued invoices.
finance.noOpenInvoices: This client has no open invoices.
finance.allocationPolicy: A payment must be fully allocated to open invoices of the client, without exceeding any balance. Overpayments are not accepted.
finance.reverseNote: Reversing keeps the payment on record, marks it reversed and recalculates every invoice it was allocated to.
finance.paymentImmutableNote: Payments cannot be edited or deleted — a wrong payment is reversed with a reason.
finance.receiptNote: Receipt files arrive with the secure documents module; keep the receipt reference in the reference field meanwhile.
finance.vatHint: Use {r}% of the net amount, or enter the VAT on the receipt.
finance.awaitingApproval: Waiting for approval in the approval center.
finance.costRatesNote: Internal costing only (not payroll). Visible to finance management; never shown to project members. Used to estimate the cost of approved time.
finance.otherCurrency: {n} invoices in other currencies are excluded (no FX conversion)
finance.terminology: Billed = issued invoice totals · Collected = recorded payments · Outstanding = invoice balances. Contract or quotation values are commitments, not revenue.
finance.notAccounting: These are operational reports. There is no general ledger, P&L, balance sheet or revenue recognition.
finance.profitNote: Margin = billed (net of VAT) − direct project expenses (net) − cost of approved time where hourly cost rates exist. Not revenue recognition.
finance.coverageText: {n}% of {h} approved hours have a cost rate.
finance.pfNote: Sections appear only with the matching finance permission. Project membership never grants financial visibility.

system.noExecutionsText: Executions appear when an enabled rule's event happens.
system.templatesNote: Built-in notifications for these situations already exist; templates only add recipients or follow-ups. They are created disabled.
system.actionsNote: Run in order; the first failure stops the run and is retried later. Completed actions are never repeated.
system.noConditions: No conditions — the rule runs for every event of this trigger.
system.ownerHint: The record owner (e.g. PM, account owner).
system.enableConfirm: Enable this rule? It will run for every new matching event.
system.editNewVersion: Saving creates a NEW version. Past executions keep the version they ran with; you become the run-as user.
system.versionsNote: Versions are immutable: each execution references the exact version it used.

health.title: System health
health.subtitle: Dependencies, jobs, queues, events and backups — live data
health.optionalNote: Optional integrations (WhatsApp, Google, NOVA…) never make the system unready — see Integrations.
health.jobsNote: A record is not proof that a process is alive: only fresh heartbeats and successes count. Stuck jobs lose their lease and another instance takes over.
health.noDeadText: Integration, rule and event failures that need a person appear here.
health.noBackupsText: Run npm run db:backup, then npm run db:verify-backup.
health.backupNote: Backups are created and verified by operational scripts (never from this page). Restore follows docs/DISASTER-RECOVERY.md.
health.metricsNote: This server instance only (no external metrics backend configured), since

errors.RULE_CONFLICT: Another enabled rule already assigns an owner for this trigger.
errors.ACTION_INVALID: An action is incomplete or invalid.
errors.ACTION_NOT_FOR_TRIGGER: This action does not apply to this trigger's record.
errors.RUN_AS_USER_INACTIVE: The run-as user is inactive — re-save the rule as an active user.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts — wait a few minutes.
errors.DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE: A required service is unavailable — try again shortly.
errors.SCAN_REQUIRED: This file has not passed a virus scan and cannot be downloaded (company policy).
